title: TAO job-record
description: One durable record per job at .tao/jobs/<id>.json, OUTSIDE any synced results tree. ONLY writer: scripts/tao_job_record.py (open/mark/redact-view). `open` binds results_dir at SUBMIT time and returns the id — the ONLY launch handle (atomic record-then-launch). Every write is redacted. 'What is running' is never read from records; poll the backend (docker ps / kubectl get / squeue) via backend_ref.

platform.description: Open set — the platform skill's short name in canonical kebab-case (built-ins: docker, slurm, kubernetes, brev, virtualenv; external skills, e.g. kratos, use their own name). The writer normalizes input (trim/lowercase/space->hyphen) into this form; never an allowlist.

backend_ref.description: Platform-native handle: container id | namespace/job | slurm job id | brev instance+container | virtualenv pid:<pid>. Null between open (PENDING) and successful native launch.

results_dir.description: Resolved at submit, written at open, never re-derived. Non-negotiable: K8s ttlSecondsAfterFinished and docker --rm make a missed write unrecoverable.

storage_tier.description: Stamped by the tao-data-io consumer at stage time — never guessed by the producer.

message.description: Platform-native sub-state rides here (ImagePullBackOff, PENDING-resources vs PENDING-priority, Insufficient-GPU) so stuck-Pending diagnosis is one call.

transitions.description: Append-only. First transition is the PENDING written by open.

err_class.description: The agent's failure classification (see tao-launch-workflow's failure-analysis criteria). ERR_INFRA is retriable; ERR_PROGRAM never.

retry_of.description: Job id this run retries (infra auto-retry chain).

parent_job.description: Experiment/loop thread for AutoML/DEFT children. Workflow-level state stays in best_rec.json / deft_state.json.

redacted.description: Every write passes scripts/redact_secrets.py. A record with a raw credential is a bug.
